take_homes: Start with one agent. Split only when the pieces need different access, a different dialect or a different stance.
The failures are at the handoffs between agents. A conflict gets dropped or a source's shorthand gets rewritten, and nobody notices.
The final briefing can be wrong even when the process looks tidy, and nothing here checks that.
